description: Source code for network socket operations in hiredis, including socket creation, configuration, connection handling, error reporting, and socket options management.

methods.name: redisContextCloseFd
methods.description: Closes the socket file descriptor in redisContext if open.

methods.name: __redisSetErrorFromErrno
methods.description: Sets an error in redisContext based on current errno, with optional prefix.

methods.name: redisSetReuseAddr
methods.description: Sets SO_REUSEADDR socket option to allow address reuse.

methods.name: redisCreateSocket
methods.description: Creates a socket of specified type and assigns it to redisContext.

methods.name: redisSetBlocking
methods.description: Sets socket blocking or non-blocking mode.

methods.name: redisKeepAlive
methods.description: Enables TCP keepalive with specified interval.

methods.name: redisSetTcpNoDelay
methods.description: Enables TCP_NODELAY to disable Nagle's algorithm.

methods.name: redisContextWaitReady
methods.description: Waits for socket to be ready for I/O with optional timeout.

methods.name: redisCheckSocketError
methods.description: Checks for socket errors using getsockopt(SO_ERROR).

methods.name: redisContextSetTimeout
methods.description: Sets receive and send timeout options on socket.

methods.name: _redisContextConnectTcp
methods.description: Establishes TCP connection to specified address and port, with optional source address and timeout.

methods.name: redisContextConnectTcp
methods.description: Connects to TCP server at address and port.

methods.name: redisContextConnectBindTcp
methods.description: Connects to TCP server with source address binding.

methods.name: redisContextConnectUnix
methods.description: Connects to Unix domain socket at specified path.
